# DCSync Detection Allowlist
# One account per line. Wildcards supported (* matches any sequence of characters).
# Accounts on this list are excluded from DCSync alerts (EID 4662 replication GUID matches).
# Computer accounts (ending in $) are always excluded regardless of this list.
#
# Add legitimate replication accounts here — Azure AD Connect sync accounts,
# third-party AD management tools, backup agents that require replication rights.
#
# Examples:
#   MSOL_*              # Azure AD Connect sync accounts (auto-generated name)
#   ADSync              # Generic Azure AD Connect account name
#   svc_backup          # Specific service account

MSOL_*
ADSync
